race.comment: ROYAL GUARDIAN (2) flew home too late when finishing second here a fortnight ago off a wide gate in she first run since contesting the Belmont Classic in July. She will be much tighter in condition for this, and is set to go one better. SAINTY CULLITY (3) has been hitting the line in each of his runs since winning by a nose here in early July, and he should have added another win in 3 starts following that effort. !400m was too short for him 2 weeks ago, and he can have the last say back to a mile. LANTA (4) has taken time to reach his full fitness this prep, and his last couple of efforts have suggested that his next win is not far away. Stick with him. LORD MOMO (5) capped off some solid runs with an overdue maiden win here a fortnight ago over 1400m. The extra 200m is no problem, and Lucy Fiore will keep the ride. Each way. GASPARDO (10) had an excuse last start at Belmont, and a form reversal here would not surprise. Include in all combos.
